title: "Manager Notes on one on ones"

# Manager Notes on one on ones

* Do not move the one on ones and do not cancel them - they need to be consistent
* Ask the same question at the start of every one on one
* Write down the answer to the question during every one on one
* Do not do one on ones Monday morning or Friday afternoon
